title: Japan: the household saving rate and the growth rate of real GDP (expenditure side), yearly, 1955-2024, on the 1968 SNA (1990 base) and the 2008 SNA (2020 base)
source: 内閣府経済社会総合研究所, 1998年度国民経済計算（1990基準・68SNA）, tables 55i5 and 55fcm1r; 2024年度国民経済計算（2020年基準・2008SNA）, tables 2024i5_jp and 2024fcm1rn_jp
series: saving_68sna_pct: the saving rate of households (including private unincorporated enterprises), saving divided by disposable income, per cent, 68SNA, 1990 base, 1955-1998; saving_08sna_pct: the same on the 2008SNA, 2020 base, net saving divided by net disposable income plus the adjustment for the change in pension entitlements, 1994-2024; growth_68sna_pct: the growth rate over the previous calendar year of real gross domestic expenditure, 1990 base, per cent, 1956-1998; growth_08sna_pct: the growth rate of real gross domestic product (expenditure side), chained 2020 prices, per cent, 1995-2024

The two bases overlap in 1994-1998 (saving) and 1995-1998 (growth); they are different series and are not spliced. Horioka (2024), Table S-1 (rows ho_t1_* of consumption_facts), prints the same saving rates, citing ESRI. ESRI's pages listing the workbooks are sources esri_h10 and esri2024 of consumption_facts (rows esri_h10_household, esri_h10_growth, esri2024_household, esri2024_growth).
